newsitem.title: CHINA: China tightens grips on foreign firm tax payment.
newsitem.headline: China tightens grips on foreign firm tax payment.

text.p: China will tighten control on payment of taxes by foreign-invested firms, the International Business Daily said on Tuesday.
The State General Administration of Taxation issued a circular recently requiring all permanent offices of foreign-invested firms to pay business and income taxes, the newspaper said.

The circular ordered local tax authorities to carry out an inspection of foreign-invested firms before June 30, 1997 and to ensure all firms are paying taxes in line with new regulations by October 1, it said. It gave no other details.
